declarations.name: AuiDateTimePicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI DateTimePicker: `<aui-date-time-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Field label and accessible name of the segment group.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound (validation, calendar days, and suggested times).

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Inclusive upper bound (validation, calendar days, and suggested times).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the hidden input carrying the ISO 8601 instant (Z).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty value is invalid (value-missing).

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the segments and the trigger button.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Prevents editing; the trigger button is disabled.

inputs.name: isDateDisabled
inputs.description: Disable days in the calendar; a typed disabled day is invalid ('This date is not available.').

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

inputs.name: disableNonWorking
inputs.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First calendar column (ISO weekday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close the popup after a time is picked (picking a day keeps it open).

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Minutes between suggested times, from midnight.

inputs.name: hourCycle
inputs.description: Clock of the segments and the suggested times; 'auto' follows the locale.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Segment order, calendar, time labels, messages, formatting; forwarded to both children.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Zone in which wall-clock input is resolved and values are displayed; also today in the calendar.

inputs.name: disambiguation
inputs.description: DST policy for nonexistent and repeated wall-clock times (typed or picked).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Arrow-key mirroring, calendar direction, and popup alignment.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: User typing or picking changed the value, validity, or DST status. Dispatched from the picker host.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: Bubbles from the inner Calendar when the user changes the visible month.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the popup is open.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the selected day (or today). No-op when disabled or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; focus inside the popup returns to the trigger button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user changes the value.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 instant with Z, or null when empty or invalid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Date Picker Dialog, non-modal variant, extended with an APG listbox of times: a labelled segmented date-time field (Date Input), a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, and a role=dialog popup containing the Calendar grid, a role=listbox of suggested times (aria-activedescendant), and a Done button.

limitations: Gregorian calendar only; years 1-9999 (Date Input range).
Minute precision; suggested times start at midnight every `step` minutes and are not offset by min.
Validation messages follow Date Input timing; validationTiming is not supported.
A typed day rejected by isDateDisabled is reported as error 'custom' with the message 'This date is not available.'; a consumer custom error takes precedence.
Suggested times in a DST gap stay listed; picking one follows `disambiguation` like typing it.
The popup has no Cancel button: picking commits; Done only closes.
